notes.title: "Blackjack Tavern" is now open for trial play！
notes.notes:
The New Product Festival "Blackjack Tavern" is now open for trial play. You can apply directly on the game's homepage. Join our game testing and provide feedback through the QQ group or Steam discussion group. Thank you for your participation.
As this is a trial version, some features may not be fully implemented, and some cards may contain bugs. We kindly ask for your understanding and encourage you to provide feedback. We are immensely grateful for your support.
